feedback.finish: Our climate has been changing naturally for thousands of years. However, these changes are being accelerated by humans nowadays.

instruction.text: Draw a line between the Sun and the Earth to learn about how the Greenhouse Effect works.
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The greenhouse effect happens because of gases in the atmosphere such as carbon dioxide (CO2) and methane.
atoms.sound: The greenhouse effect happens because of gases in the atmosphere such as carbon dioxide and meethane.

atoms.text: These gases form a layer around the Earth, so heat from the Sun gets trapped in the atmosphere — a bit like in a greenhouse!
As more greenhouse gases are released, more heat will be trapped in the Earth’s atmosphere. While some greenhouse gases are needed to keep our planet warm, humans are creating far too many.

We are doing this by burning fossil fuels to produce energy, which releases greenhouse gases as a by-product. These gases are also released when we fly in planes or drive cars, and even the cows that we farm release methane!
atoms.sound: We are doing this by burning fossil fuels to produce energy, which releases greenhouse gases as a by-product. These gases are also released when we fly in planes or drive cars, and even the cows that we farm release meethane!

atoms.a: What causes heat to be trapped in the atmosphere?
b: greenhouse gases sending heat away from the Earth
